company.tagline: MGT is your strongest service provider
company.summary: Maandeeq Global Transportation is a Hargeisa logistics company, established in 2023. It moves people and cargo across Somaliland and Somalia, and supports NGOs, UN agencies, and public projects with transport, freight, customs, procurement, and warehousing.

audience: Organizations that need vehicles, trucks, or cargo moved inside Somaliland and Somalia
positioning.offer: Third-party logistics. MGT sits between the organization that needs something moved or supplied and the vehicles, warehouses, and clearances that get it done.
positioning.proof: Named work with VSF Suisse, Zamzam Foundation, Plan International, the World Food Programme, Welthungerhilfe, UNSOM, One Earth Future, Cheetah Conservation Fund, and the Ministry of Agricultural Development on the World Bank Barwaaqo project.

messageFromGeneralManager.heading: Message from the General Manager
paragraphs: I am grateful for your continued trust in Maandeeq Global Transportation. That trust is what pushes us to do the work properly.

We use practical experience and the tools we have to deliver logistics across Somaliland: transport, freight, clearance, and supply. The aim is to make a difficult supply chain something you can rely on.
The work ahead will be shaped by better information, safer operations, and services that stay dependable as the market changes. We intend to keep our methods current so the service stays sharp.
Choosing Maandeeq Global Transportation means a partner that is available when the cargo, the vehicle, or the paperwork cannot wait. We will keep improving how the work is planned and delivered.
Thank you for the confidence you have placed in us. We will keep our word, and we look forward to the work ahead.

about.heading: About us
paragraphs: Maandeeq Global Transportation was established in 2023 in Hargeisa. The company provides light and heavy transport, freight forwarding, customs clearance, procurement, supply-chain support, and tax-exemption processing for non-governmental organizations in Somaliland.

As a third-party logistics provider, MGT connects the organization that needs the service with the vehicles, warehouses, and clearances that complete it. The work takes planning and time. The standard is that goods are handled with care, wherever they are.

The team has field experience moving cargo to destinations across the region, buying for international NGOs and UN agencies, running freight and customs for local and transit cargo, and processing tax exemptions. The approach is practical logistics, tied to how the client needs the job finished.

vision: To be a logistics company that raises the standard of transport and supply in this market, through sound partnerships and services that match how clients actually work.
mission: Deliver reliable, cost-efficient services that leave clients with a good experience.
Use local experience to keep a working operation, and to support the people who run it.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: Honor commitments to customers, employees, and clients. Do the work honestly.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Put the client’s interest first and deliver the job they actually asked for.

values.title: Teamwork
values.text: Work as one team, from the field unit to management, so the job gets finished.

values.title: Sustainability
values.text: Run logistics in a way that limits harm and takes the community into account.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: Keep up with how clients’ needs change, and adjust the service.

values.title: Compliance and safety
values.text: Follow local and international rules, and put safety ahead of shortcuts.

values.title: People
values.text: Train the team so they can deliver the work and carry the company.

values.title: Customer satisfaction
values.text: Meet the specific requirement, on time, at a fair cost.

waysOfWorking: Each division works as its own team and shares the job with the others. Clients are treated as partners. Management sits with the client, agrees what is needed, and stays on it until the work is delivered.

services.title: Vehicle leasing and light transport
services.summary: Staff vehicles and passenger transport for organizations working across Somaliland.
services.details: Light vehicles include 4x4 Surf, Prado, and Toyota Hilux, plus passenger vans, mini buses, and 30-seater buses. Toyota Land Cruisers are hired to INGOs and UN teams for travel to all Somaliland regions. Clients for this work include VSF Suisse, Zamzam Foundation, and the Ministry of Agricultural Development on the Barwaaqo project.

services.title: Trucks and heavy transport
services.summary: Truck transport for cargo that light vehicles cannot carry.
services.details: MGT handles small and medium heavy-transport jobs across Somaliland and delivers cargo to the destination the client names.

services.title: Road freight forwarding
services.summary: Overland freight to Somaliland and Somalia, with security and a set delivery time.
services.details: Goods are sent to regions across Somaliland and Somalia. Loading, unloading, and stowage follow the type of cargo. The team knows which goods need special handling.

services.title: Sea and air freight
services.summary: Freight beyond the road network, using partner agents for urgent cargo.
services.details: Sea freight is available when a shipment should travel by ocean. Urgent cargo can move by air through an associate network, aimed at a shorter delivery.

services.title: Procurement
services.summary: Food, non-food items, and hygiene materials, bought and supplied against a real requirement.
services.details: MGT supplies food and non-food items and looks for a lower total cost, not only a low unit price. The service depends on knowing what the buyer needs, what the market can provide, and which suppliers can deliver.

services.title: Customs clearance
services.summary: Clearance for cargo entering Somaliland by air, sea, or road.
services.details: A dedicated clearance team prepares the paperwork and moves cargo through the entry point. The work is done so the client can see the status of the shipment.

services.title: Tax exemption processing
services.summary: Tax-exemption files for international NGOs and UN organizations in Somaliland.
services.details: The team works the compliance steps and deals with the relevant ministries and customs units. The service is for organizations that are entitled to exemption and need the file processed correctly.

services.title: Disinfection
services.summary: Treatment of premises and goods against infectious bacteria, viruses, and malaria risk.
services.details: A dedicated team carries out disinfection for organizations that need premises or cargo treated before use.

services.title: Fumigation and pest control
services.summary: Fumigation, pest control, packing, and crating, including treatment of stored cargo.
services.details: Offered with warehousing and as a standalone service for cargo that must be treated before it is stored or moved.

services.title: Property and site support
services.summary: Moving materials between sites, and day-to-day site maintenance.
services.details: Support for organizations that need goods shifted to another compound and light maintenance while a site is in use.

services.title: Warehouse management
services.summary: Short- and long-term storage at key points in the region.
services.details: Warehouses are secured with electronic theft and fire alarms and round-the-clock guards. Hygiene checks can be certified by specialist companies. Goods stay protected for as long as the client needs, then move on by road or another mode.

services.title: Travel services
services.summary: Travel support, listed as its own unit beside car rental and freight.
services.details: A travel unit sits beside car rental and freight, for organizations that need people moved as well as cargo.
